verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a cloud browser platform that processes user and session data, so a training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair privacy question for it. The evidence pack has no data-usage policy, training opt-out, or no-training guarantee. The pages provided cover only session control, agents, webhooks, SDK, and observability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
